Title: Vinod and the Family

Cast

1. Vinod - 35 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Manoj - 58 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
3. Sanjay - 29 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Hema - 28 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
5. Sunita - 26 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
2. The bazaar - fruit stalls, a crowd

Scene 1: The village well - Day

[Vinod stands by the well. Sanjay stands near him.]

Vinod: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Sanjay: "Oh wow!"

[Vinod churns butter in the earthen pot.]

Sanjay: "Vinod, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The bazaar - Day

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Vinod haggles with the shopkeeper.]

Sanjay: "What happened?"

[Vinod pays the fruit seller.]

Sunita: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vinod walks through the crowded bazaar.]

Sunita: "Careful!"

[Vinod chases the thief through the crowd.]

Manoj: "Sunita, listen!"

[Vinod shouts for help.]

Vinod: "Show me too!"

[Vinod rides in a horse cart to the old market.]

Sanjay (excited): "What a day to remember!"
